name: Grimtotem Spying
summary: At Freewind Post, Cliffwatcher Longhorn sends you to learn what the Grimtotem are planning. Three unknown couriers visited Darkcloud Pinnacle, and guarded notes lie scattered through their village. Their words may threaten the tauren settlements of Thousand Needles.

sections.title: Eyes in the Wind
sections.body: Freewind Post clings to high spires, where its defenders watch their hostile cousins. The Grimtotem have long resented the Horde and kept to strongholds atop Darkcloud Pinnacle. Then Cliffwatcher Longhorn noticed a change. Three unknown agents arrived over several weeks and met secretly with clan leaders. He suspects they brought orders or proposed alliances against Thunder Bluff's presence in the canyon.

sections.title: Infiltration of Darkcloud Pinnacle
sections.body: Darkcloud Pinnacle is a fortified village of sheer mesas joined by wooden rope bridges. Dense patrols of hostile Grimtotem warriors and shamans guard the way in. Longhorn's scouts found the agents' messages locked in separate chests among the central dwellings and outer bluffs. You cross the settlement to recover all three notes and take the clan's private words under its watchful eyes.

sections.title: Dire Portents
sections.body: Cliffwatcher Longhorn reads the three notes you bring back, and Freewind Post's fears deepen. The messages show that the Grimtotem are coordinating with outside agents for an impending move. Longhorn does not know the full scheme. He begins preparing to protect the canyon posts from sudden betrayal.

faq.q: Who is sending agents to meet with the Grimtotem?
faq.answer: Cliffwatcher Longhorn knows only that three agents of unknown origin visited Darkcloud Pinnacle in recent weeks. Their backers remain unknown, their identity hidden in guarded notes.

aliases: how to get to darkcloud pinnacle
faq.answer: Darkcloud Pinnacle lies in western Thousand Needles, southeast of the Great Lift. A marked path with a blue totem climbs the mesa cliffs to the village, where wooden bridges join several high pinnacles.

faq.q: Why are the Grimtotem hostile to other tauren?
faq.answer: The Grimtotem believe tauren are superior to all other races and reject Cairne Bloodhoof's alliance with the Horde. Some live under a fragile peace in Thunder Bluff, while clans on Darkcloud Pinnacle are openly hostile to both the Horde and the Alliance.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Grimtotem Spying?
faq.answer: Cliffwatcher Longhorn gives you this work at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles after you have proved reliable by completing earlier tasks for the post.

faq.q: What prerequisite quests are required before this one?
faq.answer: Before Longhorn trusts you with this work, you complete 'Message to Freewind Post' and 'Pacify the Centaur'.

faq.q: What happens when you turn in the three secret notes?
faq.answer: When Cliffwatcher Longhorn reads the three notes, he is shocked and calls the news dire. He says Freewind Post must prepare defenses against the Grimtotem's scheme.

angles.text: As a tauren, the Grimtotem's betrayal strikes at a society built on harmony and family honor. Their secret meetings with unknown conspirators threaten what Cairne Bloodhoof has built.

As a member of the Horde, you depend on Freewind Post as a vital route through southern Kalimdor. Grimtotem plotting at Darkcloud Pinnacle puts the fragile supply lines between the Barrens and Tanaris at risk.
As a rogue, you can use stealth to recover the three chests from Darkcloud Pinnacle's suspended bridges and heavily patrolled buildings.
